newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil closes higher on healthy buying, NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil closes higher on healthy buying, NYMEX.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed higher on Tuesday on a combination of healthy buying and strong NYMEX products, traders said.
May gas oil settled $3 higher at $168.75 a tonne, while June Brent was 26 cents higher at $18.53 a barrel at 1648 GMT.
"We saw a lot of MOC buying which pushed it to a strong close," said one trader.

Initial strength in the market earlier in the session had been sparked by aggressive buying from a couple of players, traders said. Rumours of refinery problems in the U.S. also boosted prices, brokers said.
Strength in the NYMEX product markets ahead of American Petroleum Institute (API) data due to be released late on Tuesday also helped gas oil, traders said.
May heat was 1.82 cents higher at 58.35 cents a gallon, while May gasoline was 1.06 cents up at 63.40 cents a gallon.
